description.content: Create a new dashboard (EDITOR on the project; creator gets ADMIN).
List dashboards, optionally filtered by project (respects permissions).
Get a single dashboard by ID.
Update a dashboard's name or description.
Hard-delete a dashboard. FK CASCADE deletes associated chats.
Return the existing dashboard chat or create one.
Soft-delete a dashboard and cascade suppress its chats.
Legacy endpoint — always returns empty list (pipeline model retired).
Serve the dashboard's JS bundle (proxied from S3).
Regenerate a dashboard independently (without running finalize_steps).
